why: Telemetry for the upstream-5xx case, derived from the three shares the text states. The shape is deliberately a pair and a control: the pricing service's own 502 share and the dependency's 503 share are both 60% because 'every failure is an upstream tax-calculation call', and the third series is the zero against every other dependency, which is what makes this a dependency fault rather than a fault of the pricing service. All three are percentages, so the jitter stays inside the unit's domain -- a share of 60% can carry the corpus's ±2% noise without becoming a share no system could report.

series.quote: returned 502 on 60% of requests for 18 minutes
series.why: the checkpoint `cp-502-ratio` holds the share the text states, and it is the only number the text gives for the symptom

series.quote: Every failure is an upstream tax-calculation call answering 503
series.why: the dependency's own share: 'every failure' of a 60% failure rate is 60%, which is an arithmetic step the text supports rather than one it states

series.quote: the pricing service's own error rate against all other dependencies is zero
series.why: the control: a flat zero, which is the sentence that rules the pricing service out as the cause
